scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
description:
The Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH) scheme was launched by the Government of India on 15th July 2021. 

This scheme is specifically designed to enhance the skill development of marginalized communities. 

It aims to provide skill training to individuals from Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and other backward classes. 

The primary objective of PM-DAKSH is to empower these communities by improving their employability. 

The scheme seeks to provide skill development training to approximately 1 lakh individuals annually. 

The training programs under PM-DAKSH are aligned with the National Skill Qualification Framework (NSQF). 

The scheme aims to bridge the skill gap in various sectors of the economy. 

It focuses on providing training in sectors such as construction, hospitality, and information technology. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is substantial. 

Eligible candidates can receive up to INR 30,000 for skill training. 

This amount is intended to cover the costs of training, materials, and other related expenses. 

The PM-DAKSH scheme is implemented through various training partners. 

These partners include government institutions, NGOs, and private training providers. 

The eligibility criteria for PM-DAKSH are specific and well-defined. 

Candidates must be between the ages of 18 and 45 years. 

They must belong to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, or other backward classes. 

Additionally, candidates should have a family income of less than INR 3 lakh per annum. 

The application process for PM-DAKSH is straightforward. 

Interested candidates can apply online through the official PM-DAKSH portal. 

They must fill out the application form with accurate personal details. 

Required documents include proof of identity, income certificate, and caste certificate. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

Candidates may be called for an interview or assessment as part of the selection process. 

Successful candidates are then enrolled in the training programs. 

The training duration varies depending on the skill being taught. 

It typically ranges from 3 months to 12 months. 

Disbursement of funds occurs after the completion of training. 

Candidates must successfully complete their training to receive the financial assistance. 

The PM-DAKSH scheme is administered by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The ministry is responsible for monitoring and evaluating the implementation of the scheme. 

Contact details for the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment are available on their official website. 

The scheme also aims to promote entrepreneurship among the trained individuals. 

It provides guidance and support for those interested in starting their own businesses. 

The PM-DAKSH scheme is part of the broader Skill India initiative. 

Skill India was launched on 15th July 2015 to enhance the skill sets of the Indian workforce. 

The PM-DAKSH scheme is a significant step towards achieving the goals of Skill India. 

It addresses the specific needs of marginalized communities in the country. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of digital literacy. 

Training programs often include components on digital skills and technology. 

The government aims to create a skilled workforce that can contribute to the economy. 

The PM-DAKSH scheme has received positive feedback from various stakeholders. 

It is seen as a vital tool for social and economic empowerment. 

The scheme also focuses on creating awareness about skill development opportunities. 

Workshops and seminars are organized to inform potential candidates about the scheme. 

The government has set a target to train 1 million individuals under this scheme by 2025. 

Regular assessments and feedback mechanisms are in place to improve the training programs. 

The PM-DAKSH scheme is expected to significantly reduce unemployment rates among marginalized communities. 

It aims to create a more inclusive workforce in India. 

The scheme also encourages partnerships with the private sector for better training outcomes. 

The government is committed to ensuring that the benefits of the scheme reach the intended beneficiaries. 

Monitoring and evaluation are critical components of the PM-DAKSH scheme. 

Regular reports are generated to assess the impact of the training programs. 

The scheme is also aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). 

It contributes to the goal of promoting inclusive and sustainable economic growth. 

The PM-DAKSH scheme is an important initiative in the context of India's demographic dividend. 

With a large youth population, skill development is crucial for national development. 

The scheme aims to harness this potential by providing necessary skills and training. 

Overall, PM-DAKSH represents a significant investment in human capital development. 

It reflects the government's commitment to uplift marginalized communities through skill enhancement. 

The scheme is expected to create a ripple effect in the economy by fostering entrepreneurship and employment. 

In conclusion, the Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi scheme is a comprehensive initiative. 

It provides targeted support for skill development among marginalized groups. 

With specific financial assistance and a clear implementation framework, it aims to empower individuals. 

The scheme is a step towards achieving a skilled and inclusive workforce in India.
